SELECT l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_commitdate, l_receiptdate, (l_receiptdate - l_commitdate) AS days_late FROM lineitem WHERE l_receiptdate > l_commitdate ORDER BY days_late DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_commitdate, l_receiptdate, (l_receiptdate - l_commitdate) AS days_late FROM lineitem WHERE l_receiptdate > l_commitdate AND (l_receiptdate - l_commitdate) > 30 ORDER BY days_late DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_commitdate, l_receiptdate, (l_receiptdate - l_commitdate) AS days_late FROM lineitem WHERE l_receiptdate > l_commitdate AND l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' ORDER BY days_late DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_commitdate, l_receiptdate, (l_receiptdate - l_commitdate) AS days_late FROM lineitem WHERE l_receiptdate > l_commitdate AND l_shipdate <= DATE '1996-12-31' ORDER BY days_late DESC LIMIT 50;
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l_commitdate) AS yr, COUNT(*) AS late_count FROM lineitem WHERE l_receiptdate > l_commitdate GROUP BY yr ORDER BY yr;
SELECT MAX(l_receiptdate - l_commitdate) AS max_days_late, MIN(l_receiptdate - l_commitdate) AS min_days_late FROM lineitem WHERE l_receiptdate > l_commitdate;
SELECT l_orderkey, (l_receiptdate - l_commitdate) AS days_late FROM lineitem WHERE l_receiptdate > l_commitdate AND (l_receiptdate - l_commitdate) >= 60 ORDER BY days_late DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT c_custkey, c_name, total_spent FROM ( SELECT c_custkey, c_name, SUM(o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey GROUP BY c_custkey, c_name ) ranked WHERE total_spent > ( SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total_per_customer) FROM ( SELECT SUM(o_totalprice) AS total_per_customer FROM orders GROUP BY o_custkey ) sub ) ORDER BY total_spent DESC;

SELECT c_custkey, c_name, total_spent FROM (SELECT c_custkey, c_name, SUM(o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey GROUP BY c_custkey, c_name) ranked WHERE total_spent > (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.90) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total_per_customer) FROM (SELECT SUM(o_totalprice) AS total_per_customer FROM orders GROUP BY o_custkey) sub) ORDER BY total_spent DESC;

SELECT c_custkey, c_name, total_spent FROM (SELECT c_custkey, c_name, SUM(o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey GROUP BY c_custkey, c_name) ranked WHERE total_spent > (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total_per_customer) FROM (SELECT SUM(o_totalprice) AS total_per_customer FROM orders GROUP BY o_custkey) sub) ORDER BY total_spent DESC;

SELECT c_custkey, c_name, total_spent FROM (SELECT c_custkey, c_name, SUM(o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey GROUP BY c_custkey, c_name) ranked WHERE total_spent <= (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total_per_customer) FROM (SELECT SUM(o_totalprice) AS total_per_customer FROM orders GROUP BY o_custkey) sub) ORDER BY total_spent DESC;

SELECT c_custkey, c_name, total_spent FROM (SELECT c_custkey, c_name, SUM(o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey WHERE o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' GROUP BY c_custkey, c_name) ranked WHERE total_spent > (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total_per_customer) FROM (SELECT SUM(o_totalprice) AS total_per_customer FROM orders WHERE o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' GROUP BY o_custkey) sub) ORDER BY total_spent DESC;

SELECT c_custkey, c_name, total_spent FROM (SELECT c_custkey, c_name, SUM(o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey WHERE o_orderdate <= DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY c_custkey, c_name) ranked WHERE total_spent > (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total_per_customer) FROM (SELECT SUM(o_totalprice) AS total_per_customer FROM orders WHERE o_orderdate <= DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY o_custkey) sub) ORDER BY total_spent DESC;

SELECT c_mktsegment, COUNT(*) AS high_value_customers FROM customer WHERE c_custkey IN (SELECT c_custkey FROM (SELECT c_custkey, c_name, SUM(o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey GROUP BY c_custkey, c_name) ranked WHERE total_spent > (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total_per_customer) FROM (SELECT SUM(o_totalprice) AS total_per_customer FROM orders GROUP BY o_custkey) sub)) GROUP BY c_mktsegment ORDER BY high_value_customers DESC;

SELECT c_custkey, c_name, total_spent FROM (SELECT c_custkey, c_name, SUM(o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey GROUP BY c_custkey, c_name) ranked WHERE total_spent > (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total_per_customer) FROM (SELECT SUM(o_totalprice) AS total_per_customer FROM orders GROUP BY o_custkey) sub) ORDER BY total_spent ASC;

SELECT c_custkey, c_name, total_orders FROM (SELECT c_custkey, c_name, COUNT(o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM customer JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey GROUP BY c_custkey, c_name) ranked WHERE total_orders > (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY o_custkey) sub) ORDER BY total_orders DESC;

SELECT c_custkey, c_name, total_spent FROM (SELECT c_custkey, c_name, SUM(o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey GROUP BY c_custkey, c_name) ranked WHERE total_spent > (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total_per_customer) FROM (SELECT SUM(o_totalprice) AS total_per_customer FROM orders GROUP BY o_custkey) sub) AND total_spent < (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total_per_customer) FROM (SELECT SUM(o_totalprice) AS total_per_customer FROM orders GROUP BY o_custkey) sub) ORDER BY total_spent DESC;

SELECT n_name, COUNT(*) AS high_value_count FROM nation JOIN customer ON n_nationkey = c_nationkey WHERE c_custkey IN (SELECT c_custkey FROM (SELECT c_custkey, SUM(o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey GROUP BY c_custkey) r WHERE total_spent > (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total_per_customer) FROM (SELECT SUM(o_totalprice) AS total_per_customer FROM orders GROUP BY o_custkey) sub)) GROUP BY n_name ORDER BY high_value_count DESC;

SELECT l_shipmode, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS mode_revenue, ROUND( 100.0 * SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) / SUM(SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount))) OVER (), 2 ) AS pct_share FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_shipmode ORDER BY mode_revenue DESC;

SELECT l_shipmode, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS mode_revenue, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) / SUM(SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount))) OVER (), 2) AS pct_share FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' GROUP BY l_shipmode ORDER BY mode_revenue DESC;

SELECT l_shipmode, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS mode_revenue, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) / SUM(SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount))) OVER (), 2) AS pct_share FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate <= DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY l_shipmode ORDER BY mode_revenue DESC;
SELECT l_shipmode, COUNT(*) AS shipment_count, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS pct_share FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_shipmode ORDER BY shipment_count DESC;
SELECT l_shipmode, AVG(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS avg_revenue FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_shipmode ORDER BY avg_revenue DESC;
SELECT l_shipmode, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS mode_revenue FROM lineitem WHERE l_discount < 0.05 GROUP BY l_shipmode ORDER BY mode_revenue DESC;
SELECT l_shipmode, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS mode_revenue FROM lineitem WHERE l_discount >= 0.05 GROUP BY l_shipmode ORDER BY mode_revenue DESC;

SELECT l_shipinstruct, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS revenue, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) / SUM(SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount))) OVER (), 2) AS pct_share FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_shipinstruct ORDER BY revenue DESC;
SELECT l_shipmode, SUM(l_extendedprice) AS gross_revenue, SUM(l_extendedprice * l_discount) AS total_discount FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_shipmode ORDER BY gross_revenue DESC;
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l_shipdate) AS yr, l_shipmode, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS mode_revenue FROM lineitem GROUP BY yr, l_shipmode ORDER BY yr, mode_revenue DESC;

SELECT l_shipmode, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS mode_revenue, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) / SUM(SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount))) OVER (), 2) AS pct_share FROM lineitem WHERE l_returnflag = 'R' GROUP BY l_shipmode ORDER BY mode_revenue DESC;
SELECT ps_partkey, COUNT(DISTINCT ps_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM partsupp GROUP BY ps_partkey HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ps_suppkey) > 3 ORDER BY supplier_count DESC;
SELECT ps_partkey, COUNT(DISTINCT ps_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM partsupp GROUP BY ps_partkey HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ps_suppkey) > 2 ORDER BY supplier_count DESC;
SELECT ps_partkey, COUNT(DISTINCT ps_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM partsupp GROUP BY ps_partkey HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ps_suppkey) >= 4 ORDER BY supplier_count DESC;
SELECT ps_partkey, COUNT(DISTINCT ps_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM partsupp GROUP BY ps_partkey HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ps_suppkey) <= 3 ORDER BY supplier_count DESC;

SELECT ps_partkey, COUNT(DISTINCT ps_suppkey) AS supplier_count, AVG(ps_supplycost) AS avg_cost FROM partsupp GROUP BY ps_partkey HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ps_suppkey) > 3 ORDER BY supplier_count DESC;

SELECT ps_partkey, COUNT(DISTINCT ps_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(ps_availqty) AS total_qty FROM partsupp GROUP BY ps_partkey HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ps_suppkey) > 3 ORDER BY total_qty DESC;
